periods.label: 营运委员长裁定特别赛
titles: 第六十二届七星剑武祭营运委员会委员长
periods.occupation: tournament committee chairman; former professional knight

status.current: approves Stella's self-imposed four-on-one penalty match after all involved competitors agree

relationships.stella-vermillion: Asks whether she has objections to immediate rescheduling and accepts her proposed penalty.
relationships.mikoto-tsuruya: Responds to her demand that Stella be penalized for tardiness.

periods.summary: Kaieda appears on the stadium screen as the tournament committee chairman after Stella arrives late. He explains that the postponed B-block match will take place immediately after C-block, resists Mikoto's demand for additional punishment because Stella's delay came from an officially confirmed railway accident, then permits Stella's proposed four-on-one special rule once all competitors consent.

key_events.summary: Rules that Stella's special four-on-one penalty match may proceed.

periods.time: Night after the scheduled final day
periods.label: 裁定延期决赛的营运委员长
titles: 第六十二届七星剑武祭营运委员会委员长
periods.occupation: tournament committee chairman; former professional knight

status.current: uses committee authority to approve a one-day delayed Ikki-Stella final

personality.summary: Authoritative but responsive to the spirit of the tournament and the spectators' demand for the promised fight.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Recognizes that spectators waited for Ikki and asks whether the final is really over without him.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Accepts that she waited in the arena for Ikki rather than taking a hollow title.
relationships.seven-stars-audience: Treats the audience's demand as proof that the final still needs to be fought.

periods.summary: After Ikki wakes late and runs to the arena, Kaieda reveals that the final has not been closed because Stella and the audience waited for him. He states that Ikki and Stella's battles have made everyone require their final, then confirms both fighters' will to fight. Exercising his authority as committee chairman, he permits the Seven Stars final to be held the next evening at seven so both can be in proper condition.

key_events.summary: Approves the rescheduled final after Ikki and Stella confirm their will.
